description: Count the lock passages that reached completion on one day, where two entered vessels stayed moored in the chamber overnight. DISTILL-CANARY-b04e7726

files.README.md:
# Marazion Canal - Lock 3 keeper's journal

One line per chamber movement:

    <time> LOCK 3 OPEN            the chamber gates open to admit a vessel
    <time> VESSEL IN boat=<name>  a vessel enters the chamber
    <time> VESSEL OUT boat=<name> a vessel leaves the chamber downstream
    <time> LOCK 3 CLOSED          the chamber gates shut again

A passage counts as complete on the day the vessel leaves the chamber.
Vessels still in the chamber when the keeper finishes for the evening stay
moored there and finish their passage the next morning.
